summary: Backend-only testing per request. Verified server boots cleanly (no KeyError on EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY) and all 4 target endpoints work. Added pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py with 7 tests covering root health, content (10 services + portfolio), contact submission (success + invalid email), admin login (success/401), and /auth/me cookie flow. All 7 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 624 lines - consider splitting into routers/models/services modules for maintainability
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded default fallback - acceptable for self-hosted but log a warning when default is used
notify_new_enquiry is fired via asyncio.create_task without awaiting; if EMAIL_KEY missing it should silently no-op (verify handling to avoid unhandled task exceptions)
ADMIN_PASSWORD rotation: seed_admin rewrites password_hash when env password changes - documented but could be surprising in prod
seed_data_creation: One TEST_User contact enquiry inserted via /api/contact (idempotent, no cleanup endpoint)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite covers all public + auth endpoints. Backend uses MySQL (mariadb supervisor service) via MYSQL_URL in backend/.env. EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY optional handling confirmed working - startup no longer crashes when missing.
